content: Bi chanlase baozo sousei borun khade horosan shu wine. Ghadane, sudoroji uru huaizhi dolon fenqioghala fenjizho.
Bi pse chanlase nie lilian fugietu qienxien fugiede waradazhi kieliezho, "Kien fenqioni keighazhi shuni keighakui pei shidane?"
Asiman jiere, zemin jiere, zemin doura hhe shuni keighazhi onshichen uwo.
Peizhi keighazhi onshichen wise bi hende wilazho.
Zhanlao dundase niekozi made kieliezho, "Bu wila! Uzhe, Yuda paini shizi, jiushi Dawudeni houdei ijin injiwo. Hhe shuni keighazhi dolon fenqioni keigha shidane!"

Bi pse chanlase baozo, jieran amitu ojien, zhanlao dunda nie ghoni ghughan beizho. Alazhi daosei xianli. Hhende dolon gocha, dolon nudun wine, eneshi duyai gochude peizhi echighasan Hudai dolon ruhher wo.
Ene ghoni ghughan yo dao baozo sousei borun khase shuni agiwo.
Shuni agise jieran amitu ojien, 24 gie zhanlao ghoni ghughanyi melie papalawo. Manla qin, xian durusan antanni luzii bareizho. Ene xianshi shentulai onxian wo.
